slides.text: Well howdy, y'all! Deckhand Diego here. Today yer gonna learn ya can build anything. I'm sure of it. Mostly sure.
He ain't been sure o' nothin' since the day he was born.
Engineers try stuff, an' sometimes it goes KABOOM! Then they figure out why.
Ever' crash teaches ya somethin' ya didn't know ya didn't know. I've learned a LOT.
Three tries! The first one crawled like a turtle. The second one wobbled. The third one... she flies!
Two outta three bein' bad. That's a good Tuesday 'round here.
A.I. read a giant pile o' the internet, an' now it just guesses the next word. Like guessin' where the catfish are!
An' it's wrong 'bout as often as Dee-AY-go.
Talkin' to A.I. is like tellin' yer fishin' buddy what ya want. What, details, rules... then check his work!
Always check his work. Trust me.
Type it. Print it. Hold it. Kai made this motor holder outta nothin' but words. I use a welder.
The A.I. finds the parts an' drops 'em right in the shoppin' cart!
An' a grown-up still pushes the buy button. That's the important part.
Back in my day, instructions came in a language nobody spoke. Now the robot draws 'em, LEGO style, one step at a time.
Nine volts'd fry that little brain like a hush puppy. Two resistors shrink it down to a tiny sip it can read.
Drivin' the boat is a video game now! Fire the lasers!
Them ain't lasers, Dee-AY-go. Them's blinkin' lights.
...Fire the blinky lights!
Rocket builders, game makers, doctors, architects. Ever' kind of engineer's got a robot buddy now.
Safety first! Never tell an A.I. yer full name, yer school, or where ya live.
An' ask a grown-up 'fore ya plug anything in. Ask me how I know.
Yer turn, y'all! Write yer own A.I. message. What, details, rules... an' check it!
Now go build somethin' weird!
Weirder'n Dee-AY-go, if ya can manage it.
Hey!
